summary:
Iter59: Verified all 4 new governance features + regression. Backend pytest (test_iter59_scorecard_preview.py): 12/12 passed. GET /api/sap/scorecard returns current{governance_score=53, open_sod=71, autorem_total=16, movers_stripped=0, residual=2, avg_risk=23}, trend=8 weekly points (W25 governance_score=32 -> current 53), trend_source='derived' (expected — only one weekly snapshot). GET /api/sap/scorecard/export?format=csv returns 200 text/csv. GET /api/sap/digest/preview returns 3KB+ HTML body. POST /api/sap/governance-digest/send returns 200 (may be throttled within 60s window — expected). GET /api/sap/mover-rule returns config+candidates+log+stripped_total. Regression endpoints /sod/conflicts, /autoremediation, /workflow/activity, /identities, /jml, /digest/config, /systems all 200.

Frontend Playwright (cookie login via data-testid=auth-submit; needed networkidle wait due to platform 'resting' first hit — no code fix required): /app/sod — sod-scorecard card fully renders with all 6 KPI tiles (score-governance=53/100, score-open-sod=71, score-autorem=16, score-movers=0, score-residual=2, score-risk=23/100), scorecard-trend recharts area chart visible, scorecard-source shows 'DERIVED TREND', scorecard-export triggers CSV download 'sap-governance-scorecard.csv'. digest-preview button opens digest-preview-dialog with digest-preview-body (3027 chars of HTML); Escape closes dialog cleanly. Throttle hint verified: digest-send-now label transitions 'Send digest now' -> disabled 'Send again in 56s' -> ticks to 'Send again in 54s' after 2.5s (1s tick working, 60s per-org backoff honored from dcfg.last_at). All 15 SoD regression testids (sod-critical/high/medium/total, autorem-toggle/autorem-run, all 9 digest-* controls) render — no undefined-symbol crash from newly added recharts + Eye/Download/TrendingUp imports. /app/lifecycle — mover-rule-report card renders in EMPTY state before toggle (mover-rule-empty visible, mover-rule-total='0 mover(s) cleaned total'). Clicking mover-rule-toggle (aria-checked false -> true) triggers auto-strip sweep and populates log rows: mover-log-0 = CHG100562 / James Fischer / Finance / − MM: PO Approver / 8/9/2026 12:24:46 AM, mover-log-1 = CHG100561 / Vikram Okafor / Procurement / − SD: Billing Clerk / 8/9/2026 12:24:46 AM. mover-rule-total updates to '2 mover(s) cleaned total'. jml-movers-panel still renders with 4 movers.
critical_code_review_comments: scorecard response uses field name 'trend_source' (values 'derived'/'live') while the UI chip label shows 'DERIVED TREND'/'LIVE TREND' — the mapping is fine, but consider aligning API vocabulary (e.g., return 'derived_trend' or return the display label) to reduce translation ambiguity for future integrators.

sap_uac.py continues to grow with each iter (now ~2600+ lines after scorecard + preview + snapshot recording). The recommendation from iter58 to split into workflow/jml/digest/scorecard modules still stands.

The 60s throttle window uses digest config last_at persisted server-side; the countdown label in the UI is client-computed from that timestamp. If the user reloads mid-throttle the countdown continues correctly — verified. Good.

Auth submit form appears to require a real click after DOM is settled (networkidle) — the first-hit 'resting' preview state caused an initial login timeout that resolved on retry. Not a bug, but consider a lighter splash to avoid confusing first-time users.

success_rate.frontend: 4/4 features verified — Scorecard (6 tiles + 8-pt trend + DERIVED chip + CSV export), Digest Preview (dialog+HTML body+Escape close), Throttle Hint (label countdown 56s->54s), Mover Rule Report (empty state -> 2 log rows after toggle)

test_credentials: jblan2026@gmail.com / Obserra2026! (cookie-based; data-testid=auth-submit; wait_for_load_state('networkidle') before clicking to avoid first-hit resting delay)
seed_data_creation: Enabling mover-rule-toggle during the frontend run consumed both carried-over roles again (P-0045 Vikram Okafor -SD:Billing Clerk; P-0046 James Fischer -MM:PO Approver). candidates count is now 0 for this fork. Re-seed sap_engine mover-accumulation before re-testing the empty-state + strip flow. POST /governance-digest/send during throttle test recorded a new last_at; subsequent sends within 60s will return throttled=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) All 4 new features work end-to-end with no fixes needed. 2) Login sequence: goto('/'), wait_for_load_state('networkidle'), fill email/password, click [data-testid=auth-submit], wait_for_url('**/app/**'). 3) After mover-rule was toggled ON this run, candidates=0 and mover-rule-report shows 2 log rows persistently. 4) scorecard trend_source will remain 'derived' until a 2nd weekly snapshot is recorded by the cron. 5) Digest countdown ticks every 1s from dcfg.last_at + 60s. 6) test_iter59_scorecard_preview.py is the regression suite going forward.
rca of the issue: No issues found this iteration. Iter58's missing-imports RCA (CalendarClock/Input/Send) is fixed and remained fixed; iter59's added imports (recharts, Eye, Download, TrendingUp) are all present and verified — no ReferenceError observed in console during page render.
